Polarity matches wording in every study: fixed-type items correlate +0.87..+0.92 with each other and -0.59..-0.82 with the malleable/2R/4R items; IQB4 ('some students are smart') correlates +0.71 with IQB1 and is scored unreversed by the authors (s2.sps: manip=mean.1(IQB1,(8-IQB2R),IQB3,IQB4)), matching the script's itemcov_reverse_keyed. ANCHOR DIRECTION: every item in all seven studies has value labels 1='1 - Strongly agree', 2..6 bare digits, 7='7 - Strongly disagree'; no study runs the other way. Independent check on raw S2c: respondents answering learndich ('If given the chance, would you choose to learn more about XYZ Organization?' 1=Yes, 2=No) Yes vs No average MCMmanip1 4.57 vs 3.79, MCMmanip3 4.61 vs 3.76, MCMmanip2R 3.14 vs 4.18, MCMmanip4R 3.27 vs 4.28 -- under 1 = agree, those wanting to learn more perceive the organization as less fixed / more growth-oriented, the paper's premise; the reversed reading would have them preferring the fixed-mindset organization. Condition means are consistent in all seven studies (Mindset=+1: fixed-type items 5.31-5.97, malleable-type 2.06-2.84; Mindset=-1: 2.01-3.84 and 4.23-5.51), matching the docstring. WORDING: the same four statements are asked about MCM Consulting in S1a/S1b/S1c and XYZ Organization in S2a/S2b/S2c; so fixed*/malleable*_MCM carry 'Studies S1a, S1b (cov_study = 2, 3): ' | 'Studies S2a, S2b (cov_study = 5, 6): ' and MCMmanip* carry 'Study S1c (cov_study = 4): ' | 'Study S2c (cov_study = 7): ' (prefixes and ' | ' separator are IRW's; text after each is the variable label verbatim, curly apostrophes kept). NB the brief and the converter docstring place S2a/S2b at MCM Consulting; the S2a/S2b labels name XYZ Organization, and the labels were followed. IQB1-4 are Study 2 only (the professor), shipped unprefixed. Deviations: the S1a-S2c labels contain a hard line break mid-sentence (Qualtrics wrap artifact, e.g. 'they\ncan’t'), joined with a single space; IQB3 kept verbatim with straight quotes and no final period ('...either "have it" or they don't'). No instructions or lead-in in any label; instructions left blank. OPTIONS: resp 1 = 'Strongly agree', 7 = 'Strongly disagree' ('1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped, as prior rounds); 2-6 left blank (bare digits in every study). Every item's respondents used all 7 levels. Rights: items are study-authored adaptations (organization/professor referent) of Dweck's implicit-theory-of-intelligence statements, in the organizational-mindset line of Murphy & Dweck (2010, PSPB) -- Murphy is this paper's second author. No fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (as in batch_653 for the Dweck items themselves) -- silence = permission. Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: The fixed/malleable and MCMmanip items name MCM Consulting in Studies S1a, S1b and S1c (cov_study = 2, 3, 4) and XYZ Organization in Studies S2a, S2b and S2c (cov_study = 5, 6, 7), and the IQB items ask about a professor (Study 2, cov_study = 1), so item_text gives each study's wording labelled by study; responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree in every study, so a higher value means more disagreement with the statement.
